context.decisionSummary: After reviewing three generated ferry redesigns, Joel said: “I'll pick number three.” This selects the Tidal Twin-Hull Ferry for implementation in the current game.
context.locationAndLore: Same passenger ferry between Lantern Shore and the Highlands; no new faction or lore.

traitsToPreserve: Two curved shallow plank hulls and clear twin bow gap.
Woven reed canopy over cypress ribs, open passenger deck and benches.
Blue-green trim, coarse rope fenders and two amber lamps.
Tan-hatted ferryman in brown clothing with a short steering oar.
Low compact silhouette; no mast or sail.
